(2) THE DILUTION GIFT'S SIGN — tonly (112 tokens) reads 1.000 while the ruler (nm+cm, 4192) reads 0.684/0.309/0.716 with its own s125 dip: the canon's cm channel DILUTES a maintenance that is fully present; a channel that interferes with a PRESENT full-dose nm rehearsal is the natural carrier of the kill when nm is absent. (3) THE MASS GEOMETRY OF THE COMMITTED ARMS — the only committed arm with zero nameless mass (tonly) protects perfectly; every committed arm with >= 4080 nameless tokens and full nm (the ruler) dips; conly (cm+rt at zero nm) executes: the kill tracks nameless mass through the committed record. WEAKNESSES DISCLOSED: (a) THE AUTHORED-CONTEXT COUNTER — rtonly supervises EXACTLY the seat's own coordinates (the install hosts' pre/post windows) while cmonly supervises anchors+randoms; if the kill is address-local, rtonly kills despite less mass; (b) x57's inertness finding was about MAINTENANCE — interference-by-witnessing is a different mechanism and is not excluded by it; (c) the k=0 arm (wrong-nm + cm, zero rt) also executed — under rt-kills that kill must be attributed to the wrong-nm channel (e346's QORVATH control executed — supported); both readings survive the committed record.
